action: Lynn arriving, alone, and the camera declining to arrive with her. It walks her along the glass of the covered passage - she glances off to one side, at something we are not shown - and then abandons her for the navy scooter parked at the mouth of the cluttered space she is heading into, leaving her a small figure behind glass beyond it. B76 (01:57:20) is the only beat this window sits in, so the scooter is the new bike that beat names, and the order is the editorial point: the vehicle gets the foreground and she gets the background. Eight seconds on one setup with only a settle in it, in a film whose median shot is three - this is the approach being given room, not compressed. NOTE FOR THE WRITER: R2 does not land until 01:58:45 and nothing has been said yet. At this moment the bike is a bike outside the place she has come to; narrate it as her coming back to him, not as evidence of what he has become. Reading it forward is how the hold gets broken.
